principles.randomized: Assignment to study conditions is by chance
principles.controlled: At least one comparison condition is included; sham treatment is optional
principles.blinded: Information about assignment is withheld from specified people; this is separate from random assignment

trials.blinding: Blood-pressure assessors and cortisol laboratory personnel blinded; participant blinding reported, implementation unclear because settings differed

trials.comparison: 432 Hz music and no music, 54 participants each
trials.blinding: Not clearly reported for this trial
